wax.name: Wax Powder
wax.short: Volume and texture, without the weight.
wax.desc: The powder Thomas uses to add volume at the root and texture all over, with a natural matte finish. It goes on dry, restyles whenever you like and washes out with normal shampoo.
use: Unscrew the cap.
Shake a little powder onto dry roots.
Work it in with your fingers for volume.

pomata.name: Hair Pomade
pomata.desc: The Darta pomade to shape and define the cut. Work it in with your hands and comb through.
use: Take a small amount.
Warm it between your palms and work it through the hair.
Comb to define the shape.

olio.name: Beard Oil
olio.desc: A nourishing beard serum: a few pumps to soften the beard and give it a neat finish.
use: Press the pump 2-3 times into your palm.
Warm it up and spread from root to tip.
Comb to define the shape.

sale.name: Eco Spray
sale.tag: Spray with aloe vera and green tea
sale.short: Aloe vera and green tea, 300 ml.
sale.desc: The Darta spray with aloe vera and green tea, in a 300 ml can.
use: Spray evenly from a distance.
Comb or style as you like.

kit.name: Fade Kit
kit.short: The whole fade routine at home, for less.
kit.desc: Hair Pomade, Eco Spray and Beard Oil in one order. The set Thomas recommends to anyone leaving the chair with a fresh fade.
use: Eco Spray on your hair.
Hair Pomade to shape and hold.
Beard Oil to finish.

gift.name: Gift Card
gift.short: For a haircut, a beard trim or a product.
gift.desc: It arrives by email right after the order, ready to forward. Valid for every service and product at the studio, for 12 months.
use: Choose the amount.
You get it by email within minutes.
The recipient books in the app and shows it at the till.

club.name: Fade Membership
club.short: A fresh fade, at a fixed price.
club.desc: Two haircuts a month for €36 instead of €50. It starts with your first booking and you can cancel whenever you like.
use: Start the membership.
Book your two haircuts in the app.
Cancel at the studio, no penalties.

curlman.name: Curl Man
curlman.desc: The Darta fluid for curly hair: it defines the curls and keeps them soft.
use: Apply to damp hair.
Work it from the lengths to the ends.
Let it air dry or use a diffuser.

curlcontrol.name: Curl Control
curlcontrol.desc: The Darta product for curly hair with aloe vera and coconut oil, in a pump bottle.
use: Press the pump once or twice into your palm.
Work it through damp hair.
Style and let it dry.
